# paperclip_skill (Resource)

Manages a skill in a company's library. Assign it to agents through the `skills` attribute of `paperclip_agent`.

Only the skill's `SKILL.md` is managed. Skills from other sources, such as GitHub, cannot be edited this way.

~> Destroying this resource first detaches the skill from every agent that uses it, including agents Terraform does not manage, and reports them in a warning.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "paperclip_skill" "greenlight" {
  company_id = paperclip_company.studio.id
  name       = "Greenlight API"
  markdown   = file("${path.module}/skills/greenlight/SKILL.md")
}

# Assign it to an agent through its key.
resource "paperclip_agent" "director" {
  company_id   = paperclip_company.studio.id
  name         = "Director"
  adapter_type = "codex_local"
  skills       = [paperclip_skill.greenlight.key]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `company_id` (String) Identifier of the company whose library holds the skill. Changing this replaces the skill.
- `markdown` (String) Content of the skill's `SKILL.md`, typically loaded with `file()`.
- `name` (String) Display name of the skill. Must match `name` in the frontmatter of `markdown`, when that is set.

### Optional

- `description` (String) What the skill does. Must match `description` in the frontmatter of `markdown`, when that is set. Omit it to take the value from the frontmatter.
- `slug` (String) URL-safe identifier, derived from `name` when omitted. It forms part of `key`, so it does not follow later renames. Changing this replaces the skill.

### Read-Only

- `current_version_id` (String) Identifier of the skill's current version.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the skill.
- `key` (String) Key that agents use to refer to the skill.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Skills are imported by company identifier and skill identifier.
terraform import paperclip_skill.greenlight 3f0e4a52-6c1b-4f0e-9a43-0d1e6f5a7b21/7a9e3c1d-4b2f-4e6a-8d1c-5f0b2a7e9c34
```
